title: [AUG-27] Implement Necron circuit UI design across the product
why_we_need_this: The new Necron circuit UI concept (AUG-23 design sketch) has been approved. The current GUI uses traditional rectangular buttons and linear layouts. The redesign transforms the main content area into a circuit-node interface where all interactive elements are circles connected by luminous green lines, centered on the Record button, with vertical symmetry. This delivers the distinctive Warhammer 40K Necron aesthetic the product brand requires.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Main content area (FileUpload view) is rebuilt as an SVG/CSS circuit diagram layout:
   - Record button is a large central circular node with inner ring and glyph
   - Language select, Microphone select, System Audio toggle, and Theme toggle are smaller circular nodes positioned symmetrically around center (Language & Mic top pair, SysAudio & Theme bottom pair)
   - All nodes connected by gauss-green luminous lines with subtle energy-flow animation (stroke-dashoffset)
   - Upload dropzone positioned below center on the vertical axis with dashed Necron-styled border
   - Layout maintains strict vertical symmetry (left-right mirror along center axis)

2. Recording state transforms the circuit:
   - Center node changes from green to red (#e05555) with STOP label
   - Concentric pulsing rings emanate from center node (replaces the linear audio-level bar as the equalizer visualization)
   - 12 radial audio bars arranged circularly around center, driven by existing AnalyserNode audio level data
   - Timer, recording dot (pulsing), and "2 tracks" badge displayed below center node
   - Surrounding corner nodes dim (reduced opacity) to focus attention on recording

3. Transcript view uses the same circuit design language:
   - Session info as a central-top circular node
   - Copy, Export, and Retranscribe as smaller circular action nodes connected by lines
   - Transcript body (timestamped lines) scrollable below the action circuit

4. Sidebar gets Necron circuit touches while keeping list structure:
   - "New Session" button becomes a circular node with "+" symbol
   - Session items retain list layout but with Necron-themed styling (dot indicators, dark backgrounds)
   - Search and filter chips styled consistently with circuit aesthetic

5. All existing functionality preserved — no behavioral regressions:
   - Language/Mic selection, system audio toggle, recording start/stop, file upload/drag-drop, upload progress, transcript viewing, copy/export, retranscribe, session CRUD, theme toggle, undo delete
   - All dynamic elements (equalizer, recording indicator, upload progress) fully functional

6. Both dark and light themes work correctly using existing CSS custom properties and :root[data-theme='dark'] pattern
7. Responsive layout works at phone width (~400px) — circuit scales/stacks gracefully
8. prefers-reduced-motion disables all circuit animations
important_constraints:
- Reference the design sketch artifact from AUG-23 as the visual spec
- Use existing Necron design tokens (--necron-*, --accent, --gauss) from App.css — do not introduce new color values outside the existing palette
- SVG circuit diagrams must be inline (not external files) for theme token access
- The circuit node interactions (click handlers, select dropdowns) must remain accessible — circles need proper ARIA roles and keyboard focus states
- Energy flow animations must use CSS animations, not JS requestAnimationFrame (except the existing audio level analyser which stays as-is)
- Do not break the existing MediaRecorder, AudioContext, or file upload logic — only the visual presentation layer changes
